en.name: Arepas and masarepa
en.summary: This record covers two things. The dry precooked cornmeal keeps 6–12 months from purchase in a sealed container in a cool dark cupboard, a figure read across from degerminated cornmeal. Cooked arepas keep 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: The flour, not the cakes. Masarepa keeps 6–12 months from purchase, sealed, somewhere cool and dark; no agency publishes a shelf life for precooked cornmeal, so that span is borrowed from degerminated cornmeal, which is milled the same way. Because the germ has been removed there is very little oil in it, so it stales rather than turning rancid — a flat, cardboard smell means the arepas will taste of nothing. Cooked arepas must not be left out: they are a moist, low-acid cooked starch and follow the two-hour rule, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Cooked arepas keep 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Cook them, let them cool, then bag them airtight. Store them plain — an arepa split and filled with cheese, meat or avocado is a made-up sandwich and keeps only as long as its filling does, which is usually less. Refresh them on a dry griddle rather than in the microwave: the crust comes back, though the crumb stays denser than it was on the day.
en.freezer: 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality; kept continuously frozen they stay safe beyond that, but they dry and pick up freezer burn. Griddle them until set but still pale, cool them, then freeze flat in a single layer before bagging, so they do not weld together. Finish them from frozen on the griddle or in the oven. Raw arepa dough freezes poorly — it dries and cracks — so cook first, freeze second.
en.thawing: No need to thaw. Put frozen part-cooked arepas straight onto a hot griddle or into the oven to finish. If you do thaw them, do it in the fridge, never on the counter.
spoilage: Sour or fermented smell from refrigerated arepas.
Slimy or tacky surface where they were bagged while still warm.
Fuzzy mould spots, common in a humid kitchen.
Flat, musty, cardboard smell from the dry masarepa — stale, not dangerous, but it makes flavourless arepas.
tips: Freeze arepas part-cooked and pale; they finish far better than fully browned ones.
Store them plain and fill them after reheating.
Seal the masarepa bag properly — it takes on damp and clumps.
Label frozen batches with the date; they all look identical once bagged.

faq.q: How long do cooked arepas keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, bagged airtight and stored plain without any filling.
Yes, 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Griddle them until set but pale, freeze them flat, then finish from frozen.

faq.q: How long does masarepa flour last?
faq.a: 6–12 months from purchase, sealed in a cool dark cupboard. The figure is read across from degerminated cornmeal; no authority publishes one for precooked cornmeal itself.

zh.name: 玉米餅與預煮玉米粉
zh.summary: 這一篇其實包含兩樣東西。乾的預煮玉米粉密封放陰涼避光處，自購買日起可放 6～12 個月，這個數字是比照去胚玉米粉來看的。煎好的玉米餅放 4 °C 以下冷藏是 3～4 天，−18 °C 冷凍則是 2～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 這一段講的是粉，不是餅。預煮玉米粉密封放陰涼避光處，自購買日起 6～12 個月；沒有機關為預煮玉米粉公布保存期限，所以這個區間是從製程相同的去胚玉米粉借過來的。因為胚芽已經被去掉，油脂很少，所以它的結局是「走味」而不是「油耗」——聞起來扁平、有紙板味，就表示煎出來的餅不會有味道。煎好的玉米餅則不能放在外面：那是含水量高、低酸的熟澱粉，適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 煎好的玉米餅放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天。煎好、放涼，再密封裝袋。要收原味的——夾了起司、肉或酪梨的玉米餅等於一份現做三明治，能放多久由餡料決定，而餡料通常更短。回熱請用乾鍋煎，不要微波：外殼會回來，但內裡的組織會比當天紮實一些。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 2～3 個月是最佳品質的期限；只要全程沒退冰，超過這個時間依然是安全的，只是會變乾、出現凍燒。煎到定型但還沒上色就起鍋，放涼後單層平鋪冷凍，凍硬再裝袋，才不會黏成一坨。要吃時直接從冷凍下鍋或進烤箱煎完。生的玉米餅麵團很不耐凍，會乾裂，所以先煎再凍。
zh.thawing: 不必解凍。半熟的冷凍玉米餅直接放上熱鍋或送進烤箱煎完就好。真的要解凍，請放冷藏解凍，絕對不要放在室溫檯面上。
spoilage: 冷藏的玉米餅聞起來發酸或有發酵味。
還沒放涼就裝袋，表面變得黏手或黏滑。
長出絨毛狀霉點，在潮濕的廚房裡很常見。
乾的預煮玉米粉聞起來扁平、有霉味紙板味——那不是危險，但煎出來的餅會沒有味道。
tips: 冷凍用的玉米餅煎到定型、還白白的就好，回熱效果遠勝已經煎上色的。
收原味的，回熱之後再夾餡。
玉米粉的袋口要確實封好，它很會吸濕結塊。
冷凍的每一批都寫上日期；裝袋之後它們長得一模一樣。

faq.q: 煎好的玉米餅冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，密封裝袋、收原味不夾餡。
可以，−18 °C 下 2～3 個月品質最好。煎到定型但還沒上色，平鋪冷凍，之後直接從冷凍煎完。

faq.q: 預煮玉米粉可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放陰涼避光處，自購買日起 6～12 個月。這個數字是比照去胚玉米粉而來，沒有權威機關為預煮玉米粉本身公布數據。
